entries.zh: 听，听闻（副义〔疑〕「聽法」：听人讲法、听讲道）
entries.en: to hear, to listen (secondary, prob.: to hear the teaching)
entries.notes: L 栏短语 aqvigalli löq sien 漫漶难解，仅 oir「听」义可定；H 栏〔疑〕聽法，取传教语境「听（讲）法」为副义。

entries.zh: 听见各种奇巧（古怪）的话；听闻奇事
entries.en: to hear strange things; to listen to all sorts of clever (odd) talk
to hear (heed) counsel; to take advice
entries.notes: H／M 两栏「聽打派·tia pa pay」与 L 栏「oir el consejo（听劝）」不能对应，H 栏另有〔疑〕聽打瓜，义未详。

entries.zh: 听不入耳，听不进去；不中听
entries.en: to be unable to take in what one hears; not pleasing to the ear
entries.notes: L 栏 percenir 词形不明（或为 percibir 之异写），义依 H／M 栏「聽不入耳」定。

entries.zh: 听得入耳，听得进去；听着顺耳
entries.en: to take in (words); to sound pleasing to the ear
entries.notes: 与第 4 条「聽不入耳」相对成条；L 栏 percenir 词形不明。

entries.zh: （版面标记）「P. ante. A.」——字母 P 部起始的排检提示，非词条
entries.en: (layout marker) "P. ante. A." — section guide marking the start of letter-P entries; not a headword
entries.notes: 三栏皆空，据页眉同式标记及下文 Pabellon、Pacer 等 P 部词条判定。
H 栏〔疑〕悵，M 栏 Tiõ 与「帳」相应，故取帳。

entries.zh: 幔天帐，遮天的大帐幔（天篷）
entries.notes: L 栏空、M 栏末词 dove 不可辨读，仅 H 栏「幔天」可定，义据前后蚊帳、蚊罩类条目推得。

entries.en: mosquito cover (gauze net hung over a bed)
to graze, to pasture (animals); to feed
